sources.title: zeromodels/regnet-x-160 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: zeromodels/regnet-x-160 Paper: Designing Network Design Spaces (arXiv:2003.13678) · HF Papers RegNet is a family of ConvNets whose per-stage widths and depths follow a simple quantized-linear rule. This is the X variant: a 3x3 stride-2 stem then four stages of 1x1 -> 3x3 grouped -> [SE] -> 1x1 residual blocks.

sources.title: facebook/regnet-y-160 — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: RegNet-Y 160 is a convolutional neural network image classification model from Meta/Facebook's RegNet family, designed for efficient and scalable visual recognition. It is intended for computer vision researchers and engineers who need a high-performing backbone for tasks such as image classification, object detection, and transfer learning.

sources.title: RegNet-Y 160 Lands on Modelers.cn: A Solid CNN Backbone for the Ascend ...
sources.snippet: The model's raison d'être on Modelers.cn is straightforward: to give Ascend-ecosystem developers a pretrained, Apache-2.0-licensed backbone they can drop into PyTorch workflows. RegNet-Y 160 sits at the larger end of the RegNet family, balancing parameter count with accuracy.
